description: GE Multilin EPM 7000 power quality meter and EPM 7000T transducer, Modbus RTU/ASCII over RS-485
source: GE Vernova Multilin, "Multilin EPM 7000/7000T Power Quality Meter Instruction Manual", product revision 1.10 (1601-0266-A6)

sources.title: Multilin EPM 7000/7000T Power Quality Meter Instruction Manual
sources.note: Appendix B, Modbus register map (MM-1 to MM-32)

notes: All registers are holding registers (FC03 read, FC06/FC10 write). Addresses here are the zero-based hex addresses of the manual; the manual's decimal register numbers are one higher (e.g. 0x03E7 = register 1000).
32-bit values and floats span two registers with the high-order half first.
Factory settings in normal mode are 57600 baud, address 1, Modbus RTU. Right after power-up the RS-485 port also answers at 9600 baud, address 1 (factory initial default settings).
Energy registers are integers whose scale, digit count and decimal places follow the power and energy format setting (register 0x7535). Reset the energy after changing that format.
Per-phase power and power factor are non-zero only with a wye hookup. The EPM 7100 is not covered by this manual.

Not in this map: the integer readings block, uncompensated readings, minimum/maximum blocks and timestamps, harmonic and waveform registers, option card blocks, programmable settings, secondary readings and log retrieval.
